body:
From the medialog spec's A5, regraded against source 2026-08-29: the transport already
supports non-interactive scoped credentials - serve()'s token map carries {actor: seed}
identities, and the key's reach is whatever grants it holds. What was missing is ERGONOMICS,
and one honesty correction made at P1 (2026-08-30): WRITE STANDING IS STORE-WIDE BY DESIGN
("pointing is free; ids are unowned; the fences are the reader's") - only register and
federate carry prefix fences. A minted client's write protection is ATTRIBUTION (every delta
carries its own author) plus the readers' trust masks; the mint's printed warning says exactly
that, and never pretends a write fence the door does not hold.

Design settled: a clients.json in the home (the oauth.json pattern - read per request on an
unknown-token miss, bounded), so a minted token works with NO server restart and a revocation
binds on the very next call. `loam client mint <name>` generates a seed stored 0600 in the
home, mints the requested grants for its key (write; --register-prefix <ns> comma-separated for
several; --federate <container> likewise), writes the bearer's digest to clients.json, and prints the
bearer ONCE with the exposure warning - never the seed. `loam client revoke <name>` strikes
the grants and retires the digest.

Acceptance criteria:
- (a) A minted client writes through the MCP door as its OWN author (attribution at the delta
  level), registers inside its granted prefix and is refused outside it, two-sided. Verify:
  test/cli/client-mint.test.ts.
- (a2) The two halves of freshness are honest and SPLIT (T103's architecture): the TOKEN is
  read from clients.json per request, so it authenticates and retires with no restart; the
  GRANTS live in the served reactor from boot, so a mint or revoke beside a live server prints
  the staleness warning and the standing moves at restart. Verify: the same suite, both
  directions. Verify: test/cli/client-mint.test.ts.
- (b) Revoke retires the token on the very next request with no restart, lands the grant
  strikes at the delta level, and a sibling client's token and standing survive. Verify: the
  same suite.
- (c) The mint prints the bearer once with the store-wide-write warning in its own words, and
  never prints the seed. Verify: the same suite at the CLI output level.
- (d) loam_whoami answers the minted client as an actor with exactly its granted standing.
  Verify: the same suite.
title: loam client mint: scoped non-interactive credentials in one verb
